name: create exp dir + sync
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'mkdir -p ~/bonsai2/exp && cd ~/bonsai2/exp && LB=~/bonsai2/llama.cpp/build/bin && gcc -O2 -fopenmp -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod -DTQ_XGEMV_LIB -Dmain=tq_neon_main -c ../asm/tq_gemv_neon.c -o fwd_neon_mt.o 2>&1 | head -3' 2>&1 | head -5; cd /home/user/PULSAR-ASM && for f in fwd.c tq_gemv_neon.c tq_xgemv.c fwht.S; do ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=20 luigi@spark "cat > ~/bonsai2/exp/$f" < pulsar_arm/bonsai2/$f; done; echo "synced:"; ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'ls -la ~/bonsai2/exp/ | head -8'
